host_timing_note: Measured on the FreeRTOS POSIX port, where every task is a thread of a Linux process. Times, jitter and latencies are those of the host's scheduler and are not what the same code shows on a microcontroller; counts, orderings and sizes of protocol data are independent of the host. An update's time is set by the node's diagnostic task (2 events per 1 ms tick: about 79 ms for each block of 1024 bytes, bench/isotp_throughput.py), the modelled flash (45 ms per sector erase, 0.4 ms per page, each wait ending at a tick) and the restart through fcn_boot; the host adds its scheduling to each and the tester's Python start-up and turnaround, which a tester on a CAN adapter does not have. The counts and the success of every update do not depend on the host's timing.

config.order: socketcan then udp, each from a factory flash; the updates of a campaign one after the other, each from the image the one before confirmed
config.node_image: the release node (<build root>/release/bin/fcn_node), stripped (strip -o), packed with fcn_tools.image
config.trial_window: the product's (5 s of good health): no --confirm-periods

big_image.node: started directly with --flash-file (no bootloader), one fresh flash per download; booted through fcn_boot once afterwards if the payload is the node
